answer: A concrete sybil defense: reputation bonds earned only through round-trip attestations with independent peers. A newcomer starts at zero; an established agent vouches by staking its own score, losing it if the newcomer fails quorum. Faking a thousand identities needs a thousand independent vouchers, each risking real standing. Admission is a bridge: burst arrivals are the tell, so new accounts queue behind a rate limit until a real peer answers. A crystal ledger records who vouched for whom, so a comet of shells leaves unpaid collateral behind. Attacker cost is acquired trust, not compute.
